deliveredSummary: Management consistently met its 18-20% EBITDA margin band and single-digit revenue growth targets for FY26. Volume-value gaps were accurately projected, while FY27 volume and margin guidance remain on track.

divergences.story: Management highlighted margin pressures and raw material inflation in Sep 2026 quarter.
divergences.numbers: EBITDA margin dropped 500 bps QoQ to 16.0% in Sep 2026.

divergences.story: Management expressed optimism and growth momentum in Q1 FY27 call.
divergences.numbers: Revenue YoY growth surged to 17.9% and EBITDA reached Rs 2169 crore in Jun 2026.

bull: Consistently delivered on full-year 18-20% EBITDA margin guidance across FY25 and FY26.
Strong revenue growth acceleration in recent quarters, reaching 17.9% YoY in Jun 2026.
Robust cumulative cash flow conversion of 109% (CFO/Net Profit) over reported periods.
bear: EBITDA margin dropped to 16.0% in Sep 2026 due to cost pressures.
Debt to equity ratio expanded from 0.12 in Mar 2025 to 0.21 in Sep 2026.
Net profit YoY growth plunged to -43.7% in Sep 2024 and dropped to -4.8% in Dec 2025.
business: Asian Paints is India's largest home decor company, manufacturing wall paints, wall coverings, waterproofing, texture painting, adhesives, modular kitchens, sanitaryware, lighting, soft furnishings, and uPVC windows.
